summary.text: Life-Saving Recovery Pill is a killer move Ruan Dan names on Book Mountain.

claims.text: Zhan Bu Du beats Ruan Dan unconscious. Ruan Dan’s body is embedded in Book Mountain, mouth open and blood flowing. A bright light flashes on Ruan Dan’s body. The injuries heal quickly and consciousness returns. Ruan Dan names the killer move life-saving recovery pill and wants to struggle. Zhan Bu Du’s fist is already raised. Punches slam Ruan Dan’s head until the skull is smashed completely and brain matter flows out.

A bright light flashes on Ruan Dan’s corpse again. Immortal killer move Life-Saving Recovery Pill is named. The smashed skull heals and Ruan Dan is revived. Zhan Bu Du names pill path. Even with pseudo venerable battle strength, Zhan Bu Du cannot easily get around that healing. He punches again and kills Ruan Dan on the spot. Ruan Dan has just revived and does not react in time before the skull is smashed again.
A few breaths later the recovery method activates again, named Life-saving Recovery Pill. The shining light is much dimmer.
